name: Date Request
consent_html: By checking this box, I agree to receive text messages from {{custom_values.business_name}} about my event inquiry. Message frequency varies, message & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help.
footer_html: We keep our own calendar, so no date is reserved until a person confirms it and your agreement and deposit are in. We'll be quick.
thankyou_html:
Got it - thank you.

Your request is in. A real person will check the calendar for your date and get back to you shortly - usually the same day. Your date isn't reserved until the agreement is signed and the deposit is in, and we'll move fast on our end.
